facts.text: I have been trying to increase my online presence across different platforms, especially Instagram and Twitter.
I like my before-and-after photos on Instagram because they have been doing really well.
I gained around 200 new followers on Instagram since the beginning of March.
I am thinking of creating a series of posts showcasing my fitness journey.
I want tips and advice on how to achieve similar results.
I think I will create a Twitter thread to complement my Instagram series.
I wrote an introduction tweet for the Twitter thread that says I am excited to share my fitness journey.
I wrote that I struggled with inconsistency before achieving 200-follower growth on Instagram since March.
I wrote that I learned lessons, and that people should follow the thread for tips, lessons, and inspiration.
I wrote that one of the most important lessons I learned is the power of consistency.
I used to try to follow a 'perfect' workout routine that was unsustainable.
Now I focus on showing up every day and making progress no matter how small.
